title: Vere & co
description: Vere & Co. combines AI imagery with 3D objects to create detailed product renders. By integrating AI backgrounds with 3D models, this workflow maintains consistent product dimensions while expanding visual possibilities. It offers a fast, flexible process without losing the real product look.

process.heading: Shader Breakdown: Wine Label Materials
process.body: To achieve realistic label details, I built a custom shader stack starting with a procedural texture for the paper grain base. Using black-and-white masks, I applied bump mapping to drive the embossed logo and gold foil accents, resulting in a crisp, tactile final render.

process.heading: Hybrid Compositing: 3D Asset & AI Backgrounds
process.body: By using simple 3D proxy shapes to match the camera angle and lighting, I place the exact 3D bottle model right into AI-generated scenes for natural shadows and a seamless final look.

title: Benebites
description: For this project, I worked with Widarto Impact to visualize the BeneBites packaging in 3D. The goal was to translate the packaging design into a detailed product visualization while maintaining the brand’s dark green and premium visual direction.

process.heading: Adding Surface Detail
process.body: To bring more depth to the packaging, I used normal maps and material details to recreate the subtle embossed pattern and surface texture. This helped the packaging feel more physical while keeping the clean, premium character of the design.

process.heading: The final renders
process.body: I  explore several compositions for the BeneBites packaging, from a clean product presentation to more dynamic arrangements. Each scene was designed to keep the packaging and its visual identity at the center of the image.

title: Bonita Coffe
description: For this project, I helped Widarto Impact visualize their newly designed packaging as part of a product rebranding. My role was to translate the new visual identity into engaging 3D product visuals that showcased the packaging, colors, and overall character of the refreshed brand.

process.heading: Setting Up the Scene
process.body: I started by building the scene around the actual packaging artwork. Used the original packaging design as a reference, folding it into the 3D model to match the proportions and dimensions of the real product as closely as possible.

process.heading: Final Result
process.body: The final visuals translate Widarto Impact's new packaging direction into a series of expressive 3D compositions, giving the refreshed identity a stronger presence across different campaign visuals.

title: Klar
description: For this project, I translated Klar’s laundry packaging design into 3D product visuals, focusing on its bold pink identity and playful character. The goal was to create a set of visuals that made the packaging feel tangible while keeping the brand’s energetic look at the center.

process.heading: Details Matter
process.body: I used normal maps to add subtle details throughout the packaging, including small elements like the sticker and surface features. Even details that may seem minor can make a noticeable difference in the final render, helping the packaging feel more authentic and giving the materials a stronger sense of depth.

process.heading: A Bold and Playful Product Direction
process.body: The final renders explore Klar across several compositions, from close-up product arrangements to clean standalone shots. The strong pink environment and soft lighting help emphasize the packaging while giving the overall presentation a playful, energetic feel.

title: Freshleaf
description: Collaborating with Widarto Impact, I created 3D visualizations to bring the fresh rebranded look of Freshleaf to life. The goal was to transform their brand concepts into clean, realistic product showcases for presentation.

process.heading: Model & Layout Setup
process.body: Built efficient low-poly 3D models using actual packaging dimensions to ensure exact real-world scale and fast performance.

process.heading: Texture Mapping
process.body: Applied the official brand cover graphics directly onto the 3D geometry for clean, accurate product visualization.

title: Serum pack
description: Designed as a versatile packaging asset for personal branding and client presentations, this 3D mockup template features an amber dropper bottle paired with a matching paper box on a concrete pedestal.

process.heading: Process Breakdown
process.body: To make layout customization effortless, I set up custom UV grid masks for precise artwork alignment, used procedural shaders for realistic glass transparency and matte cardboard textures, and finished the scene with soft studio lighting for a clean, photorealistic display.

title: Alev
description: Working alongside Widarto Impact, I developed 3D product visualizations for Alev to present their brand packaging in clean, realistic settings. The renders turn initial packaging concepts into high-resolution visual assets ready for presentation.

process.heading: Hybrid Integration: 3D Renders & AI Images
process.body: I matched true-to-scale 3D product renders with AI-generated stock photography using proxy geometry to align perspective and lighting, creating a realistic and consistent final shot.

title: brendys by yuliet beauty
description: Created for Brendys by Yuliet Beauty, this project showcases high-fidelity 3D visualizations developed directly alongside the client to bring their beauty packaging concept to life.

process.heading: Process Breakdown
process.body: I modeled the cosmetic jar and floating liquid spheres using clean 3D geometry, applied realistic glass and golden materials, and used dynamic camera positioning to create an engaging product focus.
